name: Fatherlessness
overview: Scripture reveals God's compassionate care for the fatherless, portraying Him as their defender and judge who provides justice and protection (Psalms 68:5; Psalms 82:3). When earthly parents forsake their children, the Lord promises to gather and uphold them (Psalms 27:10). God's righteous judgment extends to the fatherless and oppressed, ensuring that those who would oppress them are held accountable (Deuteronomy 10:18; Psalms 10:18). Believers are called to trust in God's help and emulate His justice toward the fatherless, recognizing His special love for them (Psalms 10:14).
